C1234.title: Meituan Fined RMB 3.442 Billion for "Pick One of Two" Monopolistic Practices
C1234.summary: On October 8, 2021, the State Administration for Market Regulation imposed an administrative penalty of RMB 3.442 billion on Meituan for suspected monopolistic practices, including forcing merchants into exclusive dealing arrangements. The penalty followed an investigation into the company's "pick one of two" behavior, underscoring regulators' stringent crackdown on such practices in the platform
